clue.text: Knocked off game, having urge for food

parts.note: to poach is to take game illegally, so game knocked off (stolen) has been poached
to egg someone on is to urge them

explanation.surface: A poacher who has bagged some game and is now hungry.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg cooked in simmering water is a common breakfast dish, an example of food.

clue.text: Best tool

definitions.meaning: the ... of the bunch is the best of it
a pointed digging implement, like a pickaxe

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it means both the choicest item and a sharp digging implement.

clue.text: Officer in police operation undercuts Capone, offering diluted booze

indicators.note: in a down answer, pieces that cut in under another word come below it, so they follow it

parts.note: Al Capone, the Chicago gangster
a cop is a police officer

explanation.surface: A police sting trips up the gangster Capone, who is peddling watered-down liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'undercuts' places COP and OP beneath AL in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A bottled fruity drink with a little spirit mixed in is weak, watered-down liquor.

clue.text: Sweet thing but thick-skinned for starters

definitions.text: Sweet thing but thick-skinned for starters

parts.words: Sweet thing but thick-skinned for starters
parts.note: a sugary-fleshed fruit with a tough rind, often served as a first course

explanation.surface: Someone charming but insensitive, at least at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet thing' and 'thick-skinned' read as a person's character; 'for starters' suggests 'at first' but means as an appetiser.
explanation.definitionFit: This pale green fruit is sweet-fleshed, has a hard rind, and is a classic first course.

clue.text: Spot check about the compiler? Most ridiculous

parts.note: a dot is a spot

indicators.note: about means going around, so the word for check is placed around the setter's letter

parts.note: a test is a check
the setter refers to themself as I

explanation.surface: A spot check on the setter turns up the silliest result.
explanation.definitionFit: Dotty means daft or crazy, so the superlative is the most absurd.

clue.text: Golf disaster, filling in the holes?

parts.note: G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a rout is a crushing defeat, a disaster

explanation.surface: A golfer's terrible round, ending up in the holes.
explanation.definitionFit: This mortar paste fills the gaps between tiles, so it is a filler for holes.

clue.text: Burlesque outfit with small opening

indicators.note: opening means the letter for small comes at the front

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
kit is a set of clothes or gear

explanation.surface: A burlesque costume with a revealing small slit.
explanation.definitionFit: A burlesque is a comic parody, and a short comic sketch is much the same.

clue.text: Stuffing for tortilla won kudos — that's upset pedant

indicators.note: in a down light, upset means turned upside down, so the letters run backwards
the stuffing is the filling inside the words tortilla won kudos

explanation.surface: A tortilla's filling wins praise, which annoys a fussy critic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stuffing for' takes LLAWONK from inside 'tortilla won kudos'; 'upset' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart alec who thinks they have all the facts is a pedantic type.

clue.text: Cuddlesome companions turn stomachs after time

indicators.note: after means the pieces for turn and stomachs follow the letter for time

parts.note: an eddy is a swirl or turn of water
to stomach something is to bear it

explanation.surface: Companions so lovely they make stomachs turn after a while.
explanation.definitionFit: Stuffed toy animals are what children cuddle in bed as companions.

clue.text: Senior officers facing fanatic — hairy hard case, soft inside

parts.note: two COs, commanding officers
a nut is an enthusiast or fanatic

explanation.surface: Senior officers confront a zealot who is tough outside but gentle within.
explanation.definitionFit: The tropical palm fruit has a hairy shell that is hard, with soft white flesh inside.

clue.text: Dump where 4x4's taken, changing directions

indicators.note: the right letter becomes left, swapping one direction for the other

parts.note: four-wheel-drive vehicles are taken off-road

explanation.surface: A dump in the countryside reached only by four-wheel drive.
explanation.definitionFit: To dump something is to get rid of it, unload it on someone else.

clue.text: Family butcher's business?

definitions.meaning: meat and gore are what a butcher handles

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for one's relatives, and literally names the meat and gore a butcher deals in.

clue.text: Treatment misrepresented as hippy theory

indicators.note: misrepresented means the words as hippy theory are presented wrongly, in jumbled order

explanation.surface: A sceptic dismisses a therapy as hippy theory.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical rehabilitation by massage and exercise is a form of medical treatment.

clue.text: Exit toll

parts.note: the bell rung at someone's exit from life

explanation.walkthrough: 'Exit toll' looks like a charge paid at a motorway exit; here exit is dying and toll is a bell's ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The bell tolled to mark a death; figuratively, a sign that something is finished.

clue.text: Strong drink from Spain with pretty wrapping papers

parts.note: E is the international vehicle registration for Spain

indicators.note: wrapping means the word for pretty goes around the word for papers

parts.note: pretty as in pretty good means so, very
the press is the newspapers collectively

explanation.surface: A potent drink brought back from Spain in attractive gift wrapping.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffee brewed by forcing steam through grounds is a strong, concentrated drink.

clue.text: The woman with no ring in love gets put off

parts.note: she refers to the woman

indicators.note: no ring means the ring shape is removed from the word for love

parts.note: taken as the word itself
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A woman in love, but with no engagement ring, gets the wedding postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a plan on the shelf is to postpone it, to defer it.

clue.text: Realistic fertile blossoms covering uniform

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters surround the uniform letter
blossoms means the word fertile opens out and develops into a new form

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Fertile plants flower over a uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blossoms' turns FERTILE into TRELIFE; 'covering' puts U inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A story drawn from actual events is lifelike, faithful to reality.

clue.text: Upper-class, boarding public transport? A shock

indicators.note: boarding means getting on, so the upper-class letter goes inside the vehicle

parts.note: a tram is a form of public transport

explanation.surface: A posh person taking a bus is in for a nasty jolt.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe emotional distress following an upsetting event is a shock.

clue.text: Spurs soar after developing boxing exercise

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the rearranged letters surround the word for exercise
the word soar, once developed, takes a changed form, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: to exercise a right is to use it

explanation.surface: Spurs fans soar after a team builds up its boxing training.
explanation.walkthrough: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club, but here it is a verb meaning stirs up.
explanation.definitionFit: To spur someone is to stir or provoke them into action.

clue.text: Row initiated by father on edge

indicators.note: initiated by means the father and on pieces come before the word for row

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
a tier is a row of seats

explanation.surface: An argument started by a father who is on edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A border region marks the outer limit or boundary, the edge of territory.

clue.text: Certain kind of Russian should avoid south of Portugal?

indicators.note: should avoid means leaving out the letter for south

parts.note: someone from Siberia is one particular kind of Russian
S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: Some Russians should stay away from southern Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula holding Spain and Portugal gives this adjective, so it can describe things Portuguese.

clue.text: Informed of weekend ball, go crazy

indicators.note: crazy means the letters of weekend ball and go behave wildly and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: News of a weekend dance, telling everyone to go wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well informed is well read and full of learning on a subject.

clue.text: Lived and died on ridge as result of assault

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for died in genealogies
a welt is a raised mark on the skin left by a blow

explanation.surface: A victim who survived and later died, scarred by an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell somewhere is to live there, so this past form means resided.

clue.text: Simple to be married before, in an old-fashioned way

parts.note: ere is an archaic word for before

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned notion that marrying first was the simple course.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as in a mere child, the adjective means simple, nothing more than.

clue.text: Nature scenes, peculiarly English

indicators.note: peculiarly means oddly, so the letters of scenes appear in a strange order

explanation.surface: Landscapes that are quirkily English in character.
explanation.definitionFit: The intrinsic character of something, its basic nature, is its fundamental core.

clue.text: Vow the Parisian frames is love

parts.note: I do is the vow made at a wedding

indicators.note: frames means surrounds, so the French article goes round the word is

parts.note: le is the French for the

explanation.surface: A wedding vow said by a Parisian frames the message that love is all.
explanation.definitionFit: To worship or adore someone is to love them intensely.

clue.text: Miss ending after missing beginning

indicators.note: the word for ending must drop its first letter, the one at its beginning

parts.note: the close is the end of something

explanation.surface: Someone missing a film's ending after missing its start too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after missing beginning' takes C from CLOSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To miss a chance is to fail to win it, to let it slip.

clue.text: Party host's timely order to give guests present?

definitions.text: Party host's timely order to give guests present?

parts.words: Party host's timely order to give guests present?
parts.note: a host might announce a time and an activity, at ten o'clock everybody dance, to the people who have turned up

explanation.walkthrough: Split as AT TEN DANCE, the host's instruction; whole, it counts the guests present.
explanation.definitionFit: The number of people who turn up to an event is its turnout, the guests present.
